horizon_note: Set so Matt is in proportion to Kate and Pete seated (their heads about 1.3 m off the floor, 70% of his height) and about 85% of the door, as in the office.

lights.name: window
lights.note: Soft, diffuse morning light: the sunlit patch on the floor was painted out, so shadows stay short and close under people and furniture, falling slightly right and toward the camera.

kitchen-table.note: where Pete sits nursing his coffee

solid_note: Every listed object and prop is solid. Footprints follow each object's front line (its outline filled round the legs), extended back by depth_m.

props.name: kate-at-table
props.note: Kate at the kitchen table: the whole table set is one cast-style sprite, fitted (least squares on legs, table-top edges and the back chair) onto the painted table, whose floor shadows are kept in the painting.

props.name: pete-seated
props.note: Pete astride his desk chair backwards, facing the middle of the room; placed on the desk chair's spot.

props_note: The painting has the table set and Pete's desk chair painted out (the original is art/rooms/archive-pete-kate-flat-with-chairs.png); Kate at the table and Pete on his chair are cast-style sprites.
